ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area covering approximately 95% of the visible fluke, contrasted by a high-intensity (white/gray) distribution of circular punctate marks and one prominent vertical linear patch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive distribution of small, high-contrast annular (ring-shaped) blobs across both lobes; one significant vertically-oriented high-intensity oblong blob located on the right lobe approximately two-thirds from the median notch toward the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal vertex angle of 45 degrees, showing high vertical depth relative to the horizontal lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations characterized by sharp peaks and shallow valleys across the entire trailing edge span; most pronounced jaggedness observed at the distal lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory moving from the median notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a convex curve toward the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular and semi-circular high-contrast white rings (annular scars) distributed globally across the ventral surface, concentrated heavily in the central and lower-third of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, multi-directional grey linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner-left lobe and crossing horizontally through the right-central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, vertical, high-intensity linear scar approximately 1/10th the height of the right lobe; extensive surface pockmarking from previous parasitic or barnacle colonization across the entire field of view.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical white mark on the right lobe that serves as a high-contrast primary identifier against the low-intensity background.
